يقتصر (form VIII)
# يَقْتَصِرُ (yaqtaṣiru) /jaq.ta.sˤi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# يُقْتَصَرُ (yuqtaṣaru) /juq.ta.sˤa.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# يَقْتَصِرَ (yaqtaṣira) /jaq.ta.sˤi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
#
